purpose.en: Stretch the chest and the front of the shoulders.

text.zh: 双前臂贴住门框，身体慢慢向前穿过门口
text.en: Rest both forearms on the doorframe and lean gently forward through it
Stand in a split stance with your feet fixed.

text.zh: 胸前有拉伸感就停，保持呼吸
text.en: Stop when you feel the stretch across your chest, and breathe.

commonErrors.en: Pushing the lower back forward instead of opening the chest.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
